text:
sam (CEO): quick live thread from today's all-hands Q&A: we heard a lot about why deals slip. let's capture quick bullet reasons + a single next action per person. keep it casual.

luke (All-hands host): dropping a follow-up doc after this thread. pls paste 1-line examples (anonymized) of wins or losses.

maya (VP Sales): loss example: international fintech wanted EU-only hosting + audit logs; we only had hosted region roadmap. win example: mid-market SaaS bought because of predictable per-token costs. action: publish a short EU-region availability timeline + audit log checklist.

alice (Customer Success): win example: one customer reduced weekly review cycles after we shipped prompt templates. loss example: another churned because misaligned default output style caused UX regressions. action: CS will pilot a 3-template set per vertical and measure TTFV improvement.

jorge (Product): trend note: customers frequently ask about "how we handle auth and entitlements" (IdP, SCIM). action: product to produce an IdP compatibility doc + sample SCIM mappings by next Tuesday.

ravi (Eng): engineering root cause for some losses: our larger-llama variants hit KV cache pressure under bursty traffic causing timeouts. action: immediate: enable routing fallback to smaller-variant + emit a solid metric. longer: runtime patch in next sprint.

tanya (Solutions): concrete lost deal: retailer couldn't demo hallucination handling in 30m POC. action: Solutions to assemble a ~10-min demo script + hallucination test harness that SEs can run live.

elena (RevOps): ops ask: please add "loss_reason" and a short anonymized quote to the shared drive for each loss. also we need consistent Salesforce "why_lost" picks; i'll push a picklist update.

ops-bot: reminder: all-hands follow-up doc created: https://internal/docs/allhands/wins-losses. please add notes.

sam (CEO): approve these quick pragmatic moves. i prefer docs + mitigations shipped fast vs waiting for full product work. if you need budget for a quick on-prem quickstart, ping me.

luke (All-hands host): thanks. i'll collate these into the follow-up doc and tag owners. check back in two weeks for status updates. :thumbsup:
file_notes: All-hands Q&A follow-up thread focused on tangible next actions for customer wins/losses. single continuous thread string as required. no title field.
